description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeaveRequestServiceTrait' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Traits\Service'. The trait includes a method to retrieve an instance of 'LeaveRequestService' from a dependency injection container, and it uses another trait 'ServiceContainerTrait'. It is part of the Leave module of the OrangeHRM application, providing a reusable service accessor.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveRequestService from the dependency container.
